messages:
Omar: Quick idea: run a tiny "split+shadow" experiment targeting EU-residency logic for a subset of tenants. No commits in resident path, just observe. Low risk. Thoughts? :mag:

Sasha: Yes. Shadow mode only, strip PII or hash before sending. Also require X-Consent-Token on EU tenants.

Vik: Operational details: route 97% to primary, 3% to resident-shadow (dry-run). Shadow responses are compared asynchronously by comparator v0.4.

Omar: Telemetry we need: shadow_mismatch_rate, shadow_latency_delta_p95, shadow_cpu_usage, shadow_noncompliant_count. Set alert if mismatch_rate > 0.03% for 10m.

Sasha: Make sure KV cache is disabled for shadow requests or tag cache hits by policy_id. Otherwise false negatives.

Vik: Will add header X-Policy: eu-shadow-alpha and X-Shadow: true. resident-shadow will return 202/dry-run and never write.

privacy-bot: Confirmed: shadow logs will be masked (pii-hash) and retention set to 7d. X-Consent-Token mandatory for EU shadowing. Non-compliant requests counted and dropped from shadow.

Omar: Rollout plan: staging canary -> 2k synthetic shadow writes -> 0.5% prod for 4h -> 3% if stable. Auto-revert if mismatch_rate > threshold or shadow_latency_p95 delta > 250ms.

Sasha: Who owns rollback? Vik primary, Omar secondary. ops-bot: schedule canary when PR merges.

ops-bot: Canary queued: proxy/eu-shadow-alpha -> canary-21. Dashboard: https://obs.local/canary/21 :rocket:

Vik: I'll open the PR with proxy rule + comparator wiring. If shadow diffs are non-trivial we capture samples for privacy review before releasing.

Omar: Good. If this is clean we can follow up with a small control-plane toggle for shadowing per-tenant. For now manual experiment.
